title: ODOC-437 slice 1: exclude zero-score filler from optional-evidence selection and hold a stable pack digest (AC1)
description:
ODOC-437 slice 1. Advances AC1, and the spec criteria CTX-01 (two unrelated tasks sharing required policy select different optional evidence; unrelated zero-score sections absent) and CTX-06 (repeated identical compilation yields identical content digest and selection, excluding separately stored timestamps).

Design of record: docs/specs/opum-task-context-and-evidence-contract.md in opum-doc (origin/dev). Selection step 4 says "Exclude zero-score search candidates unless a mandatory policy or task/graph relation independently requires them"; step 6 says "Never fill unused capacity with low-value sections"; the inputs/output-identity section says the pack key is a canonical hash of the inputs and selected source hashes, with wall-clock timestamps, random run ids and changing UI state EXCLUDED from the reusable content prefix.

Leader ruling (Q4): do BOTH -- change the selection AND add the stability test. Measure with two real lore-cli tasks.

Likely touch points: src/core/retrieval.ts (candidate scoring/selection), the agent-context compilation path, and tests. Keep under about 400 lines; split before dispatch if larger.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Two unrelated REAL lore-cli tasks that share required policy select different optional evidence, and zero-score sections are absent from both packs.
Repeated identical compilation yields an identical content digest and an identical selection, with wall-clock timestamps excluded from the reusable content prefix.

plan: 1. Claim LCLI-680 and commit the claim on the slice branch (OFLE-249 order: branch, claim, commit, then dispatch).
2. Run opum-workflow:implement-assignment to exclude zero-score filler from optional-evidence selection and add the stability test (CTX-01, CTX-06).
3. Independent opum-workflow:review-assignment plus my own RED/GREEN evidence.
4. Push, PR to dev, required checks green on the exact head, squash-merge, complete the slice.
implementationNotes: Process rule for later slices: before removing a directory, list it and confirm every entry is something this task created. A gitignored path is exactly where pre-existing material hides from git status. Recorded after I removed .repro-scratch, which turned out to be a pre-existing ~203-entry gitignored tree, not just the two implementer probe files.

Process rule for later slices: derive a dispatch allow-list from a FULL-SUITE run on the changed tree, not from a grep for the symbol. Applied in round 4, and it is what closed a three-miss sequence where the allow-list, not the change, blocked the work.

Process rule for later slices: set the review base to the slice merge-base with origin/dev, not a per-round base. cli-surface.md:987 escaped the round-3 review because its round-2 commit lay outside that round window.
finalSummary: Closed LCLI-680, ODOC-437 slice 1: optional-evidence selection now excludes zero-score search candidates (spec selection step 4, mandatory-anchor exception intact), so the pack footer counts the ELIGIBLE deck. That moved the meaning of existing fields on TWO kinds, ruled a cli-contract section 7.1 change to both (DEC-163 amendment (4), opum-ai/opum-doc#750): agent.context.export 2 -> 3 and agent.workflow.projection 1 -> 2. Delivered through four implement-assignment rounds and one whole-slice review (run wf_0c77b73f-334, verdict approve), plus my own isolation measurement that settled the projection question (total/shown 255 -> 198 for identical inputs, only the selection code varying). PR opum-ai/lore-cli#493; CI run 37413399182 green on the reviewed head 0c17d532; full bun test on pinned bun 1.4.2 is 4932 pass / 1 skip / 1 fail, the single failure being the pre-existing LCLI-614 which no changed file can reach. The three minors the reviewer raised are filed as LCLI-684. Criterion advanced: ODOC-437 AC1 (spec criteria CTX-01, CTX-05, CTX-06).
